messages:
alex: Morning — quick async: pushed PR for the node SDK sample app (GH: repo/sample-apps PR #342). Also updated the quickstart doc to match the new `Client.init()` signature. Blocker: CI passes in Linux but e2e fails on my M1 laptop with a Docker networking error. Can someone triage?

maria: looking now. what error do you see on M1?

alex: thanks — the failing step is the local e2e that runs the sample against the hosted API mock. error snippet: 
```
Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:8080
 at TCPConnectWrap.afterConnect [as oncomplete] (net.js:1191:16)
```
I can repro with `./scripts/run-e2e-local.sh` (on M1, darwin). Works fine in container on linux VM.

tony: hmm could be port binding + docker for mac. try `export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///var/run/docker.sock`? also check if the mock container is actually starting — `docker ps | grep sample-mock`.

alex: tried that, mock container starts but immediately exits with code 1. logs show `error: missing OPENAI_API_KEY` (odd, the script injects a fake key).

sam: did you re-run `scripts/setup-dev-creds.sh` after the recent env var rename? we renamed `API_KEY` -> `SAMPLE_API_KEY` in the makefile last week.

alex: ugh looks like that — missed the rename. fixing now. thanks.

maria: putting a quick note on the PR: please add a short doc comment about the env var rename + a line in the quickstart so new users on mac don't hit this. small patch, ping me when ready. :+1:

docs-bot: Suggested changelist for docs: 1) quickstart section "Run locally" include `export SAMPLE_API_KEY=localtest` 2) Troubleshooting mac: add note about Docker for Mac file sharing and port forwarding. Would you like me to open a docs PR draft? (yes/no)

alex: yes, please open a draft PR for the docs-bot suggestions. also i'll push a tiny fix to the sample app to fallback to `SAMPLE_API_KEY` if `API_KEY` missing.

tony: quick code review offer — i'll take the sample app changes after you push. also can we add a CI matrix job for darwin-arm to catch M1 issues? even a smoke test would help.

amelia: (reaction) :eyes:  

sam: +1 on darwin-arm smoke job. low flakiness job: start mock, curl /health, teardown.

alex: sounds good. today: pushing the env var fix, adding a one-line doc change, filing an issue for darwin-arm smoke job. if anyone's free, please review PR #342 after I push.

maria: will review this afternoon. thanks for the quick update.

alex: thanks all — marking this thread resolved for now. will ping if the M1 repro persists. :shipit:
